raw_text: A ransomware attack forced the shutdown of a major oil pipeline in India on Wednesday, disrupting fuel supplies across three western states in what cybersecurity experts described as the most significant attack on Indian critical infrastructure. The government said fuel reserves were adequate and supply would be restored within 48 hours. The attack bore similarities to the 2021 Colonial Pipeline attack in the United States.
clean_text: Reuters reports ransomware forced shutdown of major Indian oil pipeline, disrupting fuel in three states. Government says reserves adequate, supply to restore within 48 hours. Compared to Colonial Pipeline attack.
